page.layout: One printed page of text, no margin notes. Full-width dedication heading at top (ornament, then centred title block with salutation and "S. P."). Below it, one paragraph with a decorated initial, running to the foot. Signature "A 2" at the bottom centre.

main_text.l: Archiatro Practico, D. Thomae Coccio Ethico,

l.i: clarissimi) in eo positam esse praedicat
Etenim cum Deus omnia propter semetipsum fe-
cerit: atq; adeo universa Creatura ad omnipote-
ntis sui Creatoris gloriam concelebrandā, uno quasi
impetu feruntur: tum vero maxime Homo, creat-
lutissima: quippe ad Imaginem[?] Dei conditus, intellectu
conditionis finem accuratè semper & ubique me-

main_text.l: ditari debebat. Quod tamen omne (proh dolor).

page.notes: The decorated initial is a woodcut and its letter is hard to make out; I read it as N, so the word is given as NOTAM with [?]. The word after "ad" in "ad Imaginem" is partly damaged; the final letters are read as "em" with [?]. The ornament above the heading is not text. The "A 2" signature is printed at the foot. No running head or page number is printed. Handwriting in the lower left margin is not transcribed. The dedication heading is set in capitals and spaced type, so it is given as a level 1 heading.
